purpose: Machine-readable record of every V3 protocol amendment and its rerun status. An amendment is only honest if the affected evidence was regenerated under the amended state; each entry records that explicitly.

amendments.found_by: calibration service B (never a headline case)
amendments.defect: Attaching the capture 'data' listener switched the inbound request stream to flowing mode, so applications that await (auth/session lookup) before attaching their own body readers lost the body and the 'end' event. V2 shipped the same flaw; all V2 triggers were GETs, so it never fired.
amendments.fix: pause the stream immediately after attaching, and resume explicitly the moment the application subscribes to 'data'.
amendments.rerun: N/A — applied before the capture tree was frozen (tree_hash 8a8ef009d19a7345514d87c41a1133c89674dbc08ef4306dc51bf0fdd1da7fbf); every headline capture ran against the amended, frozen tree.
amendments.fidelity_check: scripts/perf-equiv.mjs — V2-code vs V3-code capture of the same incident is identical modulo run-volatile fields. Re-verified 2026-09-09: EQUIVALENT.

amendments.scope: experiment-authored service fixture only (headline/services/koa-1998.mjs). NOT a change to the frozen capture tree, the oracle, the reducer, or the replay engine.
amendments.when: during headline runs, after koa-1998's first capture attempt
amendments.defect: The fixture's error middleware mapped every unknown throw to the incident code E_ASSERT_REGRESSION. That included replay-infrastructure throws (missing mock, live-attempt refusal), so an infrastructure failure could satisfy the incident fingerprint — a violation of the oracle safety rule that infra errors can never equal an incident.
amendments.fix: map only the historical guard's 401-status/expose throw to E_ASSERT_REGRESSION and rethrow everything else to the koa framework default.

rerun.full_rerun_scope: all 8 frozen eligible incidents, capture + 20x offline replay + frozen GREEDY reduction + 20x portable replay + buggy-vs-fixed + secret audit, from a cleared summary (no resume)
rerun.agreement_with_reported_results: every fingerprint_hash, fingerprint_class, events_total, atoms, artifact_bytes, reduce_trials, replay_classes, offline_pass, portable_pass, fix_status, fixed_status, wrong_accepts and secret_leaks value is identical to the originally reported run. Only artifact_sha differs, because artifacts embed run-volatile fields (captured_at, req_id, capture_hash, recorded time draws) — the same volatility the V2/V3 equivalence check accounts for.

non_amendments.note: Nothing else was changed after the capture freeze. No per-bug capture hooks, wrappers, or failure assertions exist in any case (0/0/0 in every burden record).
